task: Discover the trade-in value of my Intel 10th generation i5, 2021, HP laptop in fair condition, which has 8 GB memory and can be powered on, proceed for the in-store trade-in.
agent_final_answer:
The trade-in value is $91.00 (estimated Best Buy eGift Card value).

Matched device: HP - Pavilion x360 2-in-1 14" Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core i5 (Intel 10th Generation Core i5) - 8GB Memory - 256GB SSD - Luminous Gold (Model 14M-DW0023DX, SKU 6404882, Year of Release 2021).

How it was found: On Best Buy's Trade-In tool, searched "HP laptop", then filtered by Year of Release = 2021, Ram = 8 gigabytes, Processor Brand = Intel, and Processor Model = Intel 10th Generation Core i5, which narrowed to this single device.

Condition answers per the task: Screen damage = No; Condition = Fair (normal wear & tear); Functional condition = Functional (powers on and boots properly); OEM charging component included = Yes. This produced the estimated trade-in value of $91.00.

In-store trade-in: Accepted the estimated value, selected "Drop-off at a Best Buy store" (the in-store option) and clicked Continue, reaching the "Submit your trade-in" page. Filled in Email and Confirm email (han.wang.2718@gmail.com) and checked both agreement checkboxes. The final submission also requires a Phone Number, which was not provided in the task, so the form could not be fully submitted; everything else for the in-store trade-in was completed.
